card.name: Repeated word or digit in a row
card.fires_on: A word or character that repeats the one just before it, such as a doubled name (Yuan Yuan, Lang Lang, Chop chop) or a repeated digit in a table row of numbers.

modes.label: Doubled names
modes.description: The second half of a reduplicated name or word, as in a person's stage name.

modes.label: Repeated digits in tables
modes.description: A number in a table row that repeats the previous number, often 0 or 2.

card.plain: It fires when the same item appears twice in a row, like a doubled name or a repeated number in a table.
